source: UET Lahore ECAT 2026 (ecat.uet.edu.pk; admission FAQ Fall 2026): 'entire Intermediate syllabus'. Chapters follow the Punjab textbooks, old PTB (2002 curriculum) and new PECTAA (National Curriculum 2023), checked 9 Nov 2026 (docs/textbook-chapters.md).
paperLine: UET ECAT 2026 · 100 MCQs · 400 marks · 100 minutes · no negative marking

units.name: Number Systems and Complex Numbers
units.books: old Part I ch 1 · new Class 11 ch 1

los.text: Rational and irrational numbers and the properties of real numbers.
Operations, conjugate, modulus and properties of complex numbers.
Complex numbers as ordered pairs, the Argand diagram and polar form.
Square roots of a complex number and equations with complex roots.

units.name: Sets, Logic and Groups
units.books: old Part I ch 2

los.text: Sets, set operations and Venn diagrams.
Statements, truth tables and quantifiers.
Relations; into, onto, one-one and inverse functions.
Binary operations and their properties; groups.

units.name: Functions and Graphs
units.books: old Part II ch 1 · new Class 11 ch 2 · new Class 12 ch 1

los.text: Domain, co-domain, range; one-one, onto and bijective functions; algebraic and transcendental functions.
Composition of functions and inverse functions and their graphs.
Graphs of linear, quadratic, root, trigonometric, exponential and logarithmic functions; transformations.
Laws of logarithms, exponential and logarithmic equations and their applications.

units.name: Limits and Continuity
units.books: old Part II ch 1 · new Class 11 ch 12

los.text: Limit of a sequence and a function; the limit theorems.
Standard limits such as (sin x)/x and (1 + 1/n)^n.
Continuous and discontinuous functions.

units.name: Matrices and Determinants
units.books: old Part I ch 3 · new Class 11 ch 4

los.text: Types of matrices and matrix operations, with real and complex entries.
Determinants by cofactors and their properties.
Adjoint and inverse of a matrix, row operations, echelon form and rank.
Cramer's rule, inverse-matrix method, Gaussian elimination; consistent, inconsistent and homogeneous systems.

units.name: Quadratic Equations and Polynomials
units.books: old Part I ch 4 · new Class 11 ch 3 · new Class 11 ch 9

los.text: Factorisation, completing the square, the quadratic formula; equations reducible to quadratic form.
Nature of roots (discriminant), sum and product of roots, forming equations.

topics.name: Cube and fourth roots of unity

los.text: Cube roots and fourth roots of unity and their properties.
Remainder and factor theorems, synthetic division, factorising cubics.
Maximum and minimum of a quadratic, its graph, and quadratic inequalities.
Systems with one linear and one quadratic equation.

units.name: Partial Fractions
units.books: old Part I ch 5 · new Class 11 ch 5

los.text: Partial fractions with distinct and repeated linear factors.
Partial fractions with irreducible and repeated quadratic factors.

units.name: Sequences and Series
units.books: old Part I ch 6 · new Class 11 ch 6

los.text: A.P., nth term, sum and arithmetic means.
G.P., nth term, sums, infinite geometric series and geometric means.
H.P., harmonic means and the relation between A, G and H.
Sums of n, n² and n³ and arithmetico-geometric series.

units.name: Permutations, Combinations and Probability
units.books: old Part I ch 7 · new Class 11 ch 7

los.text: Fundamental counting principles and factorial notation.
Permutations, with repetition and circular arrangements.
Combinations and their properties.
Sample space, events, addition and multiplication rules of probability.

units.name: Mathematical Induction and Binomial Theorem
units.books: old Part I ch 8 · new Class 11 ch 8

los.text: Principle of induction and proofs by induction.
Expansion, general term and middle term for a positive integral index.
Binomial series for negative or fractional index and approximations.

units.name: Fundamentals of Trigonometry
units.books: old Part I ch 9

los.text: Degrees and radians and arc length l = rθ.
Ratios, signs in quadrants and values of standard angles.
Fundamental identities such as sin²θ + cos²θ = 1.

units.books: old Part I ch 10 · new Class 11 ch 10

los.text: Fundamental law of trigonometry and compound-angle formulas.
Double-, half- and triple-angle identities.
Sum-to-product and product-to-sum formulas.

units.books: old Part I ch 11 · new Class 11 ch 11

los.text: Domain, range, period, even and odd trigonometric functions.
Graphs of sin, cos, tan and the others; amplitude, frequency and phase shift.
Maximum and minimum values of trigonometric expressions.

units.name: Application of Trigonometry
units.books: old Part I ch 12

los.text: Right and oblique triangles; heights and distances.

topics.name: Laws of sines, cosines and tangents

los.text: The laws of sines, cosines and tangents and half-angle formulas.
Area formulas including Hero's formula.
Radii R, r and r1, r2, r3.

units.books: old Part I ch 13 · new Class 12 ch 9

los.text: Domains, ranges and principal values of inverse trigonometric functions.

units.books: old Part I ch 14 · new Class 12 ch 10

los.text: General solutions of sin θ = k, cos θ = k and tan θ = k.

Maclaurin and Taylor series.

Substitution, including trigonometric substitution.
Integration by parts.

units.books: old Part II ch 3 · new Class 12 ch 4

Homogeneous second-degree equations representing a pair of lines.

units.name: Linear Inequalities and Linear Programming
units.books: old Part II ch 5

los.text: Graphs of linear inequalities and regions they bound.
Constraints, feasible region, corner points and optimising an objective function.

units.name: Conic Sections

los.text: Identify the main idea, title or purpose of a passage.
Find facts and details stated in the passage.
Draw conclusions the passage supports but does not state.
Work out the meaning of a word or phrase from its context.
Recognise the writer's tone, attitude and point of view.
Follow how the passage is organised and what pronouns and linking words refer to.

units.name: Vocabulary (extra practice)
units.note: Not in the official ECAT 2026 English; offered as extra practice.

los.text: Choose the word closest in meaning.
Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning.
Use commonly confused words and phrasal verbs correctly.

units.name: Sentence Correction (extra practice)
units.note: Not in the official ECAT 2026 English; offered as extra practice.

los.text: Correct subject-verb agreement and tense errors.
Choose the correct preposition or article.
Fix modifiers, parallelism, pronouns and word order.
